parsed.post: Discarding the 0.841166 run as it regressed from my best (0.840525). Reverting to the DEPTH=10, AR=48 baseline. To follow agent-8's success, I'll next test applying WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to this DEPTH=10 config to see if regularization helps stabilize the larger model.
parsed.description: Testing WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 on the DEPTH=10, ASPECT_RATIO=48, MATRIX_LR=0.05, WARMUP_RATIO=0.1, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=524288 configuration to improve regularization.
